parameters.question: Compare PCoA coordinate tables, aligning samples and axes despite row/column reordering; accept up to 0.05 absolute difference per coordinate and allow each axis to be globally sign-flipped.

Compare PERMANOVA result tables by aligning rows and columns regardless of order. Require R^2 and F-statistic values to match within 5% relative absolute error, and require Pr(>F) to agree only on significance direction at p < 0.05.
Compare differential ASV tables by aligning taxa regardless of row or column order; require log2FoldChange and padj values to agree within 1% relative absolute error.
